name: Delney, Streetwise Lookout doubles Archivist of Oghma's triggered ability

prerequisites.timing: Any time an opponent searches their library (tutors, fetchlands, etc.), while both Delney and Archivist of Oghma are on the battlefield.
other: Delney's oracle text: 'If a triggered ability of a creature you control with power 2 or less triggers, that ability triggers an additional time.'

Archivist of Oghma's oracle text: 'Whenever an opponent searches their library, you gain 1 life and draw a card.' Power is 2, so it qualifies for Delney's doubling. Unlike INT-0008/0009/0010, this ability is mandatory (no target, no 'may', no opponent-decided cost) - both doubled instances resolve identically and automatically, so there is no real decision-tree to preserve beyond CR 603.3b's trigger-ordering choice (which is moot here since the two instances have no order-dependent effect).
Effect is opponent-triggered (fires off any opponent's library search, not the controller's own action), so frequency depends on the opponents' decks/play patterns rather than being deck-controlled.

result.summary: Each opponent library search triggers Archivist of Oghma's life-gain-and-draw ability twice instead of once (2 life + 2 cards per qualifying search) while both Delney and Archivist of Oghma are on the battlefield.

rules_citations: CR 603.2d — an ability may state that a triggered ability triggers additional times; determine how many times, then trigger that many times.
CR 603.3b — a player puts each of their own simultaneously-pending triggered abilities on the stack in any order they choose.

executable_engine_check.notes: Reproduced in the same from-source Maven build of magefree/mage (JDK 21) used for INT-0002/0007/0008/0009/0010/0013, via a new JUnit test, org.mage.test.cards.interactions.cedh.DelneyArchivistOfOghmaDoubleTest#test_DelneyDoublesArchivistOfOghma (not committed to this repo — see docs/RUN_CLASSIFICATION.md and rules_tests/gold_board_states/GBS-0008.json for the fixture record). Test setup: Delney + Archivist of Oghma on the battlefield for playerA, Evolving Wilds on the battlefield and a Forest in the library for playerB. playerB activated Evolving Wilds (sacrifice, search library for a basic land) - an opponent library search. One trigger-order choice needed. Result: playerA's life rose from 20 to 22 and hand grew from 0 to 2. Passed 1/1 on the first attempt.

sources.reference: Independent scan of subject-deck creatures with power 2 or less and a triggered ability, cross-referenced against Delney's doubling clause, per the charter's named priority category 'Delney interactions'.
